title: No API route exists to modify or delete an existing activity/audit log entry
description: Log immutability for the RBAC activity-log trail is currently enforced by the absence of any mutation route rather than by an explicit application-level guard on the ActivityLog model. Verify this end-to-end across the full routing surface, and flag it as a review gate for any future route addition.
steps: Enumerate every route registered under /api/activity-logs and /api/internal/activity-log (vibrantix-backend/src/index.js lines 65 and 78, and the handlers in activity-log.routes.js and activity-logs.routes.js).
Attempt PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests against /api/activity-logs/:id-style paths and against /api/internal/activity-log.
Attempt the same verbs directly against a known ActivityLog _id.
Confirm the framework returns 404/405 (no matching route) rather than any handler executing.
expectedResult: Only POST /api/internal/activity-log (create, internal-secret gated) and GET /api/activity-logs, GET /api/activity-logs/dashboard (read) are registered. No PUT/PATCH/DELETE handler exists for this collection via the HTTP API — every mutation attempt returns a routing-level 404/405, not an authorization-level 403. Document this as a required review item: any future PR that adds a PUT/PATCH/DELETE route touching the activity_logs collection must justify why immutability is still preserved.
